f08_v1_classifier.current_definition: unique non-superseded assessment of the claim in the subject's CURRENT proof_epoch; old-epoch assessments never satisfy and never earn EXPIRED/REJECTED/DISPUTED
f08_v1_classifier.expired_definition: current ACCEPTED, not revoked, no dispute, bound = min(valid_until, effective_until) non-nil and asOf >= bound (half-open; future valid_from is not EXPIRED)
f08_v1_classifier.display_order_rows: MISSING, PENDING_REVIEW, REJECTED, EXPIRED, DISPUTED, WITHDRAWN (display only; distinct from S2 match order)
f08_v1_classifier.f07_boundary: no claim.status/claimStatus revival; detail via accepted DR-08 evidence fields, DR-09 assessment history, DR-07 current criterion revision, subject verification aggregate
f08_v1_classifier.condition_catalogue_rule: gap vocabulary extension never auto-extends the Condition exceptions[] code list; EVIDENCE_GAP count stays evidenceGaps.total

f10_b3.grain_pinned: distinct (evidenceRef, observationKind RECEIPT|OUTCOME); unique key (evidenceRef.id, observationKind)
f10_b3.dedup: repeated same-role observations linking same evidence collapse to one row; multiplicity lives in history (DR-15), not B3
order_cursor_tuple: observationKind ASC with fixed role order RECEIPT < OUTCOME
f10_b3.total_semantics: count of distinct (evidence, role) pairs of the cycle, in-Matter, same snapshot; limit<=200 is page size only; no business UNIQUE/cap; no new routes
f10_b3.lossless_alternative: observation-evidence link grain requires observation identity in the item and a reference-vocabulary extension (no FILING_STAGE_OBSERVATION kind in the accepted 25); presented, not adopted
f10_b3.unresolved_source: no authorized clause binds an observation (or its evidence link) to (filing_id, cycle_no); DDL keys observations by (matter_id, filing_id, proof_epoch); api-contracts §1.1 has command-level expectedCycleNo only; cycles and epochs are independent per filing-model §1; minimal missing clause: stored/derived observation-to-cycle binding (candidates: data-model §5 full filing_stage_observations definition; filing-model observation-command contract) plus observation-type to role enumeration if more than two labels
f10_b3.status: PROPOSAL_WITH_UNRESOLVED_SOURCE until the mapping clause is supplied; baseline DR-12 cycle-item receipt/outcome refs inherit the same gap
